title: SiteRedirectMapping - Data API
description: Represents a site redirect from an external site to an Experience Cloud site. This object is available in API version 52.0 and later.

Action.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
Action.description: The type of the redirect. Possible values are: Permanent Temporary

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Indicates whether the redirect is enabled. Default value is false.

IsDynamic.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsDynamic.description: Indicates whether a redirect rule is dynamic. Default value is false. This field is available in API version 57.0 and later.

SiteId.description: The ID of the site for the redirect. This field is a relationship field.

Source.description: The URL of the site you want to redirect.

Target.description: The URL of the Experience Cloud site you want to users to visit.

special_access_rules: This object is available only if Digital Experiences is enabled for your org and Create and Set Up Experiences is enabled.
usage: If you build a new site on Experience Cloud but you also have an old site on a different platform, ensure that users visit the new site. Use SiteRedirectMapping to redirect users from the external site to the Experience Cloud site.
